name: Daredevil
summary: A blind lawyer who notices more than anyone in the room. Matt Murdock argues cases by day and patrols Hell's Kitchen by night, guided by supercharged senses and a radar sense.
origin: Daredevil is what happens when you give a lawyer the night shift. As a boy in Hell's Kitchen, Matt Murdock pushed an old man clear of an oncoming truck and was splashed in the face by a radioactive canister. He lost his sight, but every other sense went into overdrive, and he gained a radar-like awareness of the world around him. Stan Lee and Bill Everett launched him in Daredevil #1 in 1964, with Jack Kirby chipping in, and Everett's own daughter, who was legally blind, helped shape the idea. By day Matt argues cases; by night he fights crime with acrobatics, martial arts and a trick billy club. Frank Miller later made him Marvel's best-loved Catholic guilt machine.
powers: Supercharged hearing, touch, smell and taste
Radar sense that maps his surroundings
Fights with a multi-use billy club

storyline.title: The blind lawyer
storyline.beat: Young Matt Murdock is blinded by radioactive chemicals while saving a man from a truck, but his other senses become superhuman. He becomes a lawyer by day and avenges his boxer father by night.

storyline.title: A new look
storyline.beat: His original yellow-and-black costume is swapped for the all-red suit in issue #7, drawn by Wally Wood.

storyline.title: Ninjas and noir
storyline.beat: Frank Miller turns the struggling title into a gritty crime saga, introducing the assassin Elektra and the ninja clan the Hand, and making the Kingpin Matt's arch-enemy.

storyline.title: Torn down
storyline.beat: The Kingpin learns Matt's secret identity and systematically wrecks his life, career and home. Matt rebuilds from nothing in what many call the definitive Daredevil story.

storyline.title: Outed
storyline.beat: Matt's identity is leaked to the press. He spends years denying it in court and at one point declares himself the protector and ruler of Hell's Kitchen.

storyline.title: Lightening up
storyline.beat: Mark Waid brings a brighter, swashbuckling tone and wins Eisner Awards for the run.

gossip.truth: Stan Lee and Bill Everett created him in 1964. Miller arrived 15 years later and reinvented his tone.

gossip.text: The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles' origin is a deliberate nod to Daredevil: the ooze canister in their first comic comes from the same truck accident that blinded Matt.
Daredevil's first costume was mostly yellow. The all-red suit arrived in issue #7.
When Miller took over, Daredevil was a bimonthly book in danger of cancellation. His run made it one of Marvel's hottest titles.
Elektra, Matt's college love turned assassin, first appeared in Daredevil #168 in 1981.

quiz.q: What is Matt Murdock's day job?
Which New York neighbourhood does Daredevil protect?
quiz.why: He grew up in Hell's Kitchen and still guards it.

quiz.q: Which crime boss tears Matt's life apart in Born Again?
quiz.why: Wilson Fisk learns his identity and ruins him.

theme.tagline: Can't see you. Can hear your heartbeat lying.

timeline.title: A blind lawyer in yellow
timeline.note: Daredevil #1 introduces Matt Murdock in a yellow-and-black suit, fighting for his late father's memory.

timeline.title: Going red
timeline.note: Daredevil #7 debuts the all-red horned costume, and pits Matt against the Sub-Mariner in a famous losing fight.

timeline.title: Frank Miller arrives
timeline.note: Frank Miller starts drawing the book with #158, and soon writes it too, turning it into gritty crime noir with ninjas.

timeline.title: Enter Elektra, enter Fisk
timeline.note: Miller introduces Elektra in #168 and makes the Kingpin Matt's main enemy, setting up the rivalry for decades.

timeline.title: Born Again
timeline.note: Miller and David Mazzucchelli have the Kingpin learn Matt's secret and tear his whole life apart piece by piece.

timeline.title: TV movie with the Hulk
timeline.note: Rex Smith plays Matt in The Trial of the Incredible Hulk, a TV movie that teams him with Bill Bixby's Banner.

timeline.title: Netflix's Hell's Kitchen
timeline.note: Charlie Cox stars in Daredevil on Netflix, a bruising street-level series known for its long hallway fight scenes.

timeline.title: Daredevil: Born Again
timeline.note: Charlie Cox returns on Disney+ in Daredevil: Born Again, bringing the Netflix-era cast into the official MCU.
